tools.name: get_profile
tools.title: Get my academic profile
tools.description: Get the signed-in student's UniGenius profile: display name, department, current semester, roll number and Pro status.

tools.name: get_attendance_summary
tools.title: Get attendance summary
tools.description: Summarise the signed-in student's attendance per subject (present, absent, percentage) for a semester, with the most recent records.

semester.description: Semester number to summarise. Omit for all semesters.

subject.description: Filter to a single subject name.

tools.name: get_study_plan
tools.title: Get my study plan
tools.description: Get the signed-in student's latest generated weekly study plan, including subjects, weekly hours and schedule.

tools.name: list_flashcard_sets
tools.title: List my flashcard sets
tools.description: List the signed-in student's saved flashcard sets, with card counts and optionally the cards themselves.

includeCards.description: Include the cards of each set (default false).

limit.description: Maximum number of sets to return (default 20).

tools.name: list_study_materials
tools.title: List study materials
tools.description: List teacher-uploaded study materials available to the signed-in student, optionally filtered by subject or semester.

limit.description: Maximum number of materials to return (default 20).

tools.name: list_upcoming_exams
tools.title: List upcoming exams
tools.description: List upcoming exams from the university exam schedule, optionally filtered by semester.

limit.description: Maximum number of exams to return (default 20).

tools.name: log_study_session
tools.title: Log a study session
tools.description: Record a completed study session for the signed-in student so it counts toward progress tracking.

durationMinutes.description: How long the session lasted, in minutes.

notes.description: Optional notes about what was covered.
